location_matching: Same database lookup convention and four soil observations as the original bundled soil sample. Private coordinates and database IDs are omitted; tables share site_id.
perturbation: Landsat and climate numeric values multiplied by factors within 0.975-1.025. QA bits and dates unchanged. Carbon and terrain copied from the existing obscured sample.
sensors: Landsat 7, 8 and 9 have observations in this period; Landsat 5 has none.
